info.name: Qualys API (VM/PC)
info.description:
Community-maintained reference collection for Qualys API (VM/PC).

This primary collection shows the latest documented endpoint version for each operation. Earlier Host List versions remain preserved in the structured catalog and will be published separately as a lifecycle-labeled archive. Host Update V2 is retained because Qualys has not documented a newer update action.

Authentication defaults to Basic HTTP authentication with {{username}} and {{password}}. For IdP JWT authentication, set {{accessToken}} in your local environment and change this collection's authentication type to Bearer Token.

Use a Qualys API server URL without a trailing slash for {{baseUrl}}. Never commit credentials, access tokens, or tenant response data.

item.name: Changes - Host attributes (safety gated)
item.description: Uses action=update, which changes host attributes rather than listing hosts. The released PDF documents POST only. The current HTML heading says GET/POST, but its parameter table and every sample use POST; the collection therefore exposes POST only pending a clear published GET example. Set allowTenantChanges=true, review values, and enable the action field before sending.

urlencoded.description: Updates selected host attributes. Required. Disabled as a safety gate; enable only after setting allowTenantChanges=true.
Echoes submitted parameters in the XML response when set to 1. Optional. Documented values: 0, 1.
Selects one or more host IDs; host-ID ranges are not accepted. Required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles.
Selects IPv4 addresses, ranges, or CIDR values to update. Required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles. Alternative: POSTed CSV raw data.
Restricts the request to a custom network ID; defaults to Global Default Network when omitted. Required: valid only when Network Support is enabled.
Restricts the request to a custom network name. Required: valid only when Network Support is enabled.
Filters selected IP addresses by their current tracking method. Optional. Documented values: IP, DNS, NETBIOS.
Requires a single IP and updates only when its DNS hostname matches this value. Optional.
Requires a single IP and updates only when its NetBIOS hostname matches this value. Optional.
Selects hosts in the specified asset-group IDs or ID ranges. Required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles.
Selects hosts by strings in their asset-group titles. Required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles.
Sets a new tracking method. EC2 and Agent tracking cannot be set or changed. Optional. Documented values: IP, DNS, NETBIOS.
Sets a new eligible owner for the selected hosts. Optional.
Sets user-defined field 1, up to 128 ASCII characters. Optional.
Sets user-defined field 2, up to 128 ASCII characters. Optional.
Sets user-defined field 3, up to 128 ASCII characters. Optional.
Sets the user-defined comment for the selected hosts. Optional.

request.description: Update hosts - V2. Lifecycle: EOS (EOS December 2025; EOL December 2026) as of 2026-09-20. The published lifecycle table covers the versioned Asset Host path, but no V6 Host Update action is currently documented. Do not assume a V6 update replacement exists. This request can change tenant data.

exec: throw new Error('Safety gate: set allowTenantChanges=true, review the request, then enable action before sending.');
